title: deliver progress event
description: One line of <git-common-dir>/.agents/events/<run>.jsonl (or $AGENT_EVENTS_DIR/<run>.jsonl), written by scripts/Report-Progress.ps1. Fields are only added; readers ignore unknown fields and unknown types; a change in meaning bumps v. `tone` is decided once by the emitter, each display maps it to its own palette. Tone table: attention kind pr_opened -> success; review_fix, paused, needs_you, release_test -> warning; ci_red, blocked -> danger. step.finished: step done, pr, merge or merged -> success; review with result containing 'fix' -> warning; ci with result matching red or fail -> danger; step or result paused -> warning; step or result blocked -> danger. issue.finished outcome: delivered -> success, paused -> warning, blocked -> danger, skipped -> neutral. run.finished result: done -> success, no progress -> warning, blocked -> danger, other -> neutral. Every other event is neutral. needs_you and release_test also set needsYou: true.

type.description: Known: run.started, milestone.progress, issue.started, step.finished, attention, issue.finished, release.updated, run.finished. Readers ignore unknown types.

kind.description: attention: pr_opened, review_fix, ci_red, paused, blocked, needs_you, release_test

result.description: run.finished: done, max reached, blocked, no progress, ...

reviewRound.description: release.updated: round of the release review
